clips.title: The story
paras: Braenna Flintcrag is a dwarven priest trainer stationed within the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. She instructs devout followers of the Holy Light, guiding dwarven acolytes as they develop their spiritual disciplines and healing arts. She also passes word to visiting night elf priests when they are called home to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

Residing within the quiet alcoves of the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Braenna Flintcrag serves the Alliance as a dedicated priest trainer. While Ironforge is renowned for its roaring forges and martial warriors, devout dwarves like Braenna tend to the spiritual welfare of Khaz Modan. She mentors novices answering the call of the Holy Light, teaching the dual disciplines of restorative mending and defensive warding required to survive in an increasingly dangerous world.
